body.purpose: Read sold units grouped by sale date and calendar interval.
when_to_use: Read sold units grouped by sale date and calendar interval.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer sales from imports; revenue, profit, forecast, and vendor-attributed sales are unsupported.

rules: day, week, month only; weeks start Monday; edge buckets are clipped.
These are SALE date bounds, both provided or neither.

preconditions: Read bookstore://reference for vendor IDs and fixed clock.
Use ISO paired dates, known IDs, and no unsupported parameters.
